questions.stem: The data set $2, 5, 8, 100$ has a mean of $28.75$. Which average would be more representative of this data?

options.text: The mean, because it uses all the data
The median, because it is not affected by the outlier $100$
The mode, because it is the most common value
The range, because it shows the spread

questions.explanation: The value $100$ is an outlier that pulls the mean up to $28.75$, which does not represent the majority of the data. The median ($6.5$) is a better measure of central tendency here as it is resistant to outliers.
